article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: SOE announced that Free Realms would launch on the PlayStation 3 via the PlayStation Network in North America on March 29th (2011), with the PC version's activities, minigames and adventures and a streamlined console UI. The post lists PC-version features: 15 jobs, over 30,000 wearable combinations, eight environments, free-to-play with about 800 quests (jobs to level four) and Membership (about 400 extra quests, jobs to level 20, offered as one month, three months, six months or lifetime).

article_summaries.title: Free Realms is Now Available On The PlayStation Network
article_summaries.summary: SOE announcement that Free Realms became a free download on the PlayStation Network for PS3, with a streamlined console UI, voice chat, and trophies. The page gives the post age only as a relative '3 days, 14 hours ago' with no absolute date, so the exact launch date is unknown from this copy. It also summarizes the live game's job count, quest counts, membership tiers and environments.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - Quais são as Novidades? (Free Realms on the PlayStation®Network in Europe!)
article_summaries.summary: A SOE news post (Portuguese-locale page, English text) announcing that Free Realms launched on the PlayStation 3 via the PlayStation Network in Europe on September 28th. It summarizes the PS3 version's features: jobs, mini-games, housing, pets, free-to-play with membership, and parental controls. The year is not stated in the text and the page's relative date ('1 mês, 1 semana atrás') is not an absolute date.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms on the PlayStation®Network in Europe!
article_summaries.summary: SOE announced that Free Realms became available on the PlayStation 3 through the PlayStation Network in Europe on September 28 (year inferred from the capture date, as the post itself gives no year). The post describes the PS3 version's features: mini-games, 15 jobs, eight environments, free-to-play with Membership options, and PS3 parental controls. The page gives no new prices or patch details.
